name: How do I choose the right AEO provider for my criminal defense practice?
description: Choose an AEO provider with legal marketing experience, transparent methods, relevant case studies, customized strategies, and clear communication.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right AEO provider for my criminal defense practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an AEO provider, look for a firm with proven experience in legal marketing and a deep understanding of AI search technologies. Inquire about their specific AEO methodologies, transparent reporting practices, and client case studies, especially those relevant to the legal sector. A good provider should offer customized strategies, not one-size-fits-all solutions, and have a clear communication process for updates and results.
